disclaimer: Brain findings in dyslexia show variability across individuals. These findings represent group-level patterns from research studies, not diagnostic markers for individuals. Neuroplasticity means the brain can change with intervention. The brain is highly complex and no single region determines reading ability.
visualizationNote: This data represents a simplified model of brain regions involved in reading. Actual brain organization is more complex with extensive interconnections and individual variation.
